title: Drifts on lower roofs.
officialText:
In areas where the ground snow load, P , as determined by Section 1608.2, is equal to or greater
g
than 5 psf (0.240 kN/ m2), roofs shall be designed to sustain localized loads from snowdrifts in accordance with Section 7.7 of
ASCE 7.
